secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (https://<project>.supabase.co). Found in Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API. Alternatively provide VITE_SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable key. Found in Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API (the 'anon public' key).

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Supabase project ID (alternative to VITE_SUPABASE_URL; the URL is derived as https://<id>.supabase.co).

secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_ID
secrets.description: Legacy Base44 app id (optional — no calls go to Base44; the app is 100% Supabase).

secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Legacy Base44 backend URL (optional — unused at runtime).
